facts.claim: Wise offers three products serving personal customers, small and medium-sized businesses, and banks and other enterprises: Wise Account, Wise Business, and Wise Platform.
facts.excerpt: We serve each of these customer groups through our three products: the Wise Account for personal customers, Wise Business for small and medium-sized businesses and Wise Platform for banks and other enterprises.

facts.claim: More than 15.6 million customers used Wise for cross-border transactions in FY2025.
facts.excerpt: During FY2025 over 15.6 million customers used Wise for cross-border transactions

facts.claim: Wise said FY2025 growth was led by expanding its active customer base, while it reduced prices and broadened its product offering.
facts.excerpt: We continued investing in our customers by reducing our prices and building the infrastructure they need to move and manage money around the world, while also broadening our product offering.

facts.claim: Wise Account and Wise Business let people and businesses hold over 40 currencies, move money between countries, and spend abroad.
facts.excerpt: With Wise Account and Wise Business, people and businesses can hold 40+ currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad.

facts.claim: Wise launched a multi-currency Interest feature in Canada for people and businesses.
facts.excerpt: Wise has announced the launch of its new Interest feature for people and businesses in Canada.

facts.claim: In FY2023, Wise payments were instant 55% of the time, and the company described its fees as transparent and its service as cheaper than banks.

strategy.observation: Wise’s three reported products—Wise Account, Wise Business and Wise Platform—serve customers through financial services and money-movement technology.
strategy.offer_link: Forklift maintenance contracts address warehouse equipment upkeep. The facts establish no warehouse operations or equipment responsibilities that would connect this offer to Wise’s Head of Product.
hypotheses: The Head of Product likely focuses on Wise’s financial products rather than warehouse equipment maintenance.
A relevant opportunity would require Wise to operate warehouses with forklifts, which the supplied facts do not establish.
strategy.angle: Given Wise’s focus on account and payment products, I suspect my warehouse forklift maintenance offer is outside your remit.
strategy.fit_reason: There is no supported use case for forklift maintenance at Wise or a plausible connection to this recipient’s role; this prospect should not be prioritized for the offer.
